positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "85 MILLION Americans rely on CHIP and Medicare. This affordable access is life-changing! I joined @ProtectOurCare today because we can't afford to roll back the clock on healthcare. It's time to increase access to and expand these essential resources!"

"In Congress, I am hard at work to find common-sense solutions to bring down the costs of healthcare and lower the cost of prescription drugs. I am committed to preventing insurance companies from increasing premiums and deductibles while reducing coverage. I will continue to fight for paid family and medical leave, so when someone is sick, they stay home and keep us all safe. I vote to cap the cost of critical prescription drugs and insulin, and I defend the Affordable Care Act and work every day to expand on it."
